verdict.line: You lose if you burn Counter Strike (E) early or trade freely into her Q (Precision Protocol) resets; you win by holding E for her Wall Dive commit and out-scaling her once Trinity Force completes.

brief.thesis: Jax's E (Counter Strike) is a direct answer to Camille's all-in shape: her only hard engage before 6 is the second-cast Wall Dive from E (Hookshot), and activating Counter Strike mid-channel stuns her through it, turning her commitment into a free trade for you. That single interaction is why Jax holds lane and solo-kill advantage here (52.7% over 731 games) despite Camille's reputation as one of the strongest lane bullies in the game.

theirWindow.when: At level 2 with Q and W
theirWindow.what: Once she has Precision Protocol (Q) and Tactical Sweep (W), she can poke with true damage from range without committing E; do not chase or extend the trade, just eat the poke and let minions soak the cone.

yourWindow.when: When she commits to Wall Dive (E)
yourWindow.what: Hold Counter Strike (E) uncast until she throws the second Hookshot cast to dive onto you, then pop it mid-channel to stun her and deny the empowered auto from her passive — this is the exact interaction that flips the matchup in your favor.

start.why: The higher-pick-rate start (58.8% pick, 52.1% wr over 509 games) rewards the aggressive trade pattern this matchup wants: short auto trades punished immediately once your E timing lines up, not passive poke absorption.

boots.why: Measured as the stronger boots here (50.8% over 553 games, 68.8% pick); flat damage reduction blunts the sustained auto damage from her passive's on-hit proc during extended duels.

core.why: Spikes your Empower (W) proc damage and gives the movement speed to close the gap after landing a Counter Strike (E) stun, converting the stun into a full combo instead of a partial trade.
The on-hit proc and healing on your first strike each fight lets you punish the moment she commits Wall Dive even harder, and offsets the true damage she does land pre-stun.
This path measures 56.7% over 120 games; Zhonya's lets you survive her Hextech Ultimatum (R) all-in after 6 if you're caught out of position or dove alongside jungle pressure.

situational.when: she's building lethality or on-hit burst and you need the bleed-into-heal to survive her all-in damage
the game goes long and you need current-health shred to close out extended duels against her armor stacking
you're getting bursted down in trades and need an early shield buffer before her true damage stacks up

runes.keystoneWhy: This page measures the higher win rate (51.2% over the 30.1%-pick sample); ramping attack speed rewards you for turning a landed Counter Strike (E) stun into a sustained auto-trade window rather than needing a single burst combo, which is where Jax naturally wins once her all-in is neutralized.

summoners.why: Ignite converts your measured solo-kill advantage directly into kills the moment your Counter Strike (E) stun lands; Flash+Teleport (55.4% over 31.1% pick) is the alternative if you want to prioritize wave/side-lane management over closing out solo kills.

playing.title: Hold E for her E
playing.detail: Never use Counter Strike to farm or dodge poke — save it specifically for the moment she commits the second Wall Dive cast, since popping it mid-channel stuns her and denies the empowered auto from her passive.

playing.title: Eat Q, don't chase
playing.detail: Precision Protocol (Q) resets her next auto for bonus true damage at range without full commitment; take the poke and let minions block the follow-up Tactical Sweep (W) cone instead of trading back into it.

playing.title: Leap onto minions to engage pre-6
playing.detail: Camille has no hard engage before level 6, so use Leap Strike (Q) onto a minion to close distance and force her to react before she can set up her own combo.

playing.title: Freeze early, shove after Trinity
playing.detail: Hold the wave near your tower through levels 1-5 to deny her cs and bait a desperate Wall Dive into your stun; once Trinity Force completes, push to threaten plates instead.

playing.title: Respect Hextech Ultimatum after 6
playing.detail: Her R (Hextech Ultimatum) can leash you in place from range once she hits level 6 — don't overstay near walls or brush inside her ult range, and keep Flash for repositioning, not engaging.

playing.title: Convert stuns into kills with Ignite
playing.detail: The moment your Counter Strike lands, burn Ignite — her low base HP pool empties fast under Empower (W) plus Ignite, matching the measured solo-kill edge in this matchup.

playing.title: Track Trinity Force timing as your spike
playing.detail: Your dueling advantage jumps hardest once Trinity Force is complete, typically levels 9-13; play for trades around this item spike rather than forcing all-ins beforehand.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on patch 16.18.1; the timing reads, ability interactions, and trade logic are this brief's own tactical judgment, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Use Counter Strike [E] when Camille closes in using Wall Dive (E) to stop her from dealing additional damage. You will have the upper hand if you manage to stun her.
